title: A proof assumes a hatch two reference levels below its cited code (set -> lemma_a -> lemma_b with admit()), and that change introduces the law's assumption obligation; an admit outside the cone does not

assert.why: A.7.5.1 rule 9: DefaultPolicy critical blocks unestablished

A.5.4.4: cone(r) closes set and lemma_a under Refs° (set -> lemma_a -> lemma_b), so M_h's admit fact at lemma_b is an assumption of the proof, undeclared (no boundary allows admit), giving reason assumption (A.5.4.1, A.5.4.3); introduced because that record's cone meets Δcode at lemma_b although Req (set@unit, set@closure) did not move (A.7.3.3 [D4]); binding = every Req pair (A.7.2.2)
no hatch rule is declared, so the admit fact contradicts nothing
the proof is usable and establishes the law
A.5.4.4: lemma_c is not in the cone (no refs or calls reach it from set or lemma_a), so its admit is no assumption of the proof
